messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: Hosted API p95/p99 spike in us-east-1. Request queue growing > 3x baseline, autoscaler failing to provision GPU nodes. Paging on-call. Seen 429/timeouts.
alice.ops: ack — I'm on it, grabbing runbook.
bob.oncall: I'm taking pager. any idea if provisioner logs show rate-limits or quota errors?
cara.sre: early signal: provisioner create VM calls returning 403 quotaExceeded for the tenant project (cloud-quotas). also seeing 504s from provisioner to cloud API.
alice.ops: thanks. immediate mitigation: enable per-customer rate limit and fallback to smaller model variant for non-SLA traffic. will push a temporary route change.
dave.support: flagging customers: acme-marketing and beta-analytics seeing 10-20% errors, others degraded latency. CS is on standby to notify top 5.
emma.ps: setting incident severity to sev2 due to multiple paying customers impacted.
bob.oncall: applying route change now: /v1/generate low-priority -> variant-small, preserve high-priority tokens.
alice.ops: command I ran: ``POST /api/routes/update {"route":"/v1/generate","policy":"priority-preserve","fallback":"variant-small"}`` — pushing, response 200.
cara.sre: confirm provisioner errors: snippet from logs: ``2026-03-17T19:12:03Z provisioner: create-instance failed: error=quotaExceeded project=redwood-prod region=us-east-1``. Also seeing throttling 429s from cloud API.
bob.oncall: trying burst-capacity alternative: request to Dedicated reserved pool for overflow — sending manual allocation request to capacity team.
dave.support: PS update: acme-marketing reported timeouts in the dashboard, p95 ~ 4.6s -> now p95 ~ 18s, p99 ~ 28s. Customer-facing error is 504/timeout and occasional 429s.
emma.ps: ENRICH: estimated customer impact window 20-40 minutes if we don't get nodes. escalate to platform lead if no capacity in 10m.
alice.ops: temporary throttle policy enabled globally for anonymous/low-priority keys. observing queue growth flattening but still high.
cara.sre: we should also bump eviction safety to allow smaller models to be preempted to free slots for high-priority inference. considering increased eviction aggression by 15%.
bob.oncall: approved. applying: ``PATCH /infra/autoscaler {"evictionAggressiveness": "high"}``
alice.ops: applied patch, kube events show some evictions and rebinds. New pods coming up but slow due to cloud API 429s.
dave.support: CS just messaged acme that we're mitigating, will send update in 15.
emma.ps: provisioner request to capacity team returned: "manual review required due to quota hold; ETA 12-24h unless uplift approved" — not immediate.
cara.sre: that means autoscaler can't win here. keep fallbacks and throttles. we need a post-incident item to request quota uplift and a pre-approval flow.
bob.oncall: rolling back non-essential scheduled jobs that create GPU instances. also enabling short-circuit cache for repeated identical prompts for 10m to reduce tokens.
alice.ops: stats: queue backlog decreased from 18k -> 6.2k after fallbacks and throttles. p95 down to ~7.8s, p99 ~14.5s. still above target but improving.
emma.ps: marking current state: degraded but partial mitigation. handing off to night on-call in 30m. leaving runbook and links.
bob.oncall: handoff notes: watch for cloud 429 rate; keep throttles on; if queue >10k alert me immediately.
dave.support: will continue customer comms; escalation path open.
incident-bot: UPDATE: alerting rules suppressed for noisy p95 alerts; critical alerts still active.
cara.sre: postmortem note: root cause likely quota exhaustion combined with sudden campaign spike from partner X. action items: 1) quota uplift request for us-east-1, 2) pre-approved emergency capacity process, 3) evaluate burst reserve for top-tier customers.
alice.ops: creating ticket now and will link runbook attachments.
emma.ps: thanks everyone. handing over official incident channel to night-oncall in 30m.
